entity: 40 big California water systems serving 4.2M people with no full sanitary survey on EPA's file in 5 years
why: No source names the 40 systems or any count like ours. The state Water Board's own 2021 report is the same kind of finding in general: sanitary-survey completion fell to 78% and was dropping. That's the pattern - surveys going undone - without our entities or the 5-year absence measure.
